fields: main kind, priority, CPU, time slice, WC encoding
argument: Parameterless procedure Main; no priority/CPU/time-slice pragma or binder override; bracket encoding configuration. Main body statements do not write these fields.

fields: DB, Ex, ID, Lx, Qx, Tx, UA
argument: Fixed compiler/runtime configuration; no corresponding source or configuration pragma is admitted. All 82 fixed P records are ZX or SS ZX.

fields: CE, GP, NC, NO, NR, NS, Ox, ZX
argument: Successful native object compilation under fixed target/mode/options; no new errors, proof mode, no-runtime, scalar-normalization or storage-order directive. Some fields are consistency inputs rather than direct bindgen reads; their selected values remain fixed.
SS is a P token, not a separate record. The fixed closure already sets it through non-exempt ALIs; the monotone True merge absorbs any Main contribution.
Main has no tasks or task allocators. No fixed closure ALI has a T record. The selected quantity override is absent, so secondary-stack count is one for the main task.

Fixed restriction settings and parameter fields; Main contributes no checked parameter restriction. Boolean variation is absorbed by the 30 fixed closure violations. The complete 100-member restriction partition is retained separately.
Only the canonical Main U token checksum varies semantically. Gen_Versions emits its eight hex digits in a fixed Version_32 declaration. Fixed dependency versions do not vary.

fields: Uname, Sfile, Utype, Unit_Kind, Predefined, Internal, My_ALI, SAL_Interface, Directly_Scanned
argument: Main remains the same non-generic library subprogram body and source-name role. No SAL/library/replay route is selected. All other units, file roles and order are the accepted fixed closure.

fields: BD, BN, DE, EB, EE, NE, PR, PU
argument: Main executable statements occur inside its body and add no library elaboration code; NE stays true, EE is absent, and no package/generic/elaboration directive enters. Closure flags/order retain the accepted graph transfer. BD/BN/DE/EB/PR/PU have no direct bindgen field read; their graph/check consumers remain the inherited closure interface.
Main is a subprogram, never a non-generic package with a finalizer. The fixed packages alone determine Has_Finalizer and generated finalization routines.

fields: IL, IU, KM, KU -> Icasing, Kcasing
argument: May vary with source casing. Main No_Elab takes the earlier branch, so its Icasing is not serialized; fixed units retain fixed casing. Kcasing has no bindgen consumer.
No Initialize_Scalars setting or Invalid_Value use is admitted; the fixed ALIs contain no IS. No Main declaration can add scalar initialization.

fields: Ox, RA, RC, RT, SE, SP
argument: Optimization alignment/configuration and successful compilation are fixed; no remote/shared-passive feature. These fields have no direct bindgen reader; their retained consistency/closure consumers are unchanged.

fields: W/Z closure; interrupt and dispatch tables; linker options; binding environment; target switches
reader: ali.adb:readers under retained binder row policy
argument: No new with, pragma, CUDA, interrupt, dispatch, linker option or environment directive occurs. Fixed closure/configuration drives all other serializer branches; comments/path spellings retain the accepted width/renaming transfer.
